voiceoverSegments.line: We start by loading 1000 candles of OHLCV data, giving the strategy its price history to work with.
Next we add a 40‑period EMA, smoothing the price to highlight the medium‑term trend.
Then we overlay a 20‑period EMA, which reacts faster to short‑term price moves.
We compare the two EMAs with a greater‑than node, producing a signal when the faster EMA tops the slower.
We plot the 40‑period EMA so its trend line appears on the chart.
Next we plot the 20‑period EMA, giving us a second line to watch for crossovers.
We then run the strategy through the backtest engine to see how the crossover rule performs.
Finally we plot the trades, marking entries and exits so the results are visible on the chart.

outro.voiceover: You now see the two EMAs crossing with trade signals plotted, ready to backtest the strategy.
